column2: [chaos_chief.GetTitledName] has begun to raise a camp of hide tents, bone fences and blood-daubed totems in [This.GetName]. The Wastes swallow most such places within a generation
column3: only time will tell if this one will last.

column2: The warping land of the Wastes has §Kwrecked§! part of the camp at [chaos_settlement.GetName]. The ground split open overnight, and the tents and pens that stood there are gone. The settlement is set back.

The camp at [chaos_settlement.GetName] has stood against the tides of the Wastes for years. It is time to raise it into something greater: a trading town where slavers and raiders sell their spoils, or a Dark Fortress to guard our lands.
It will be the greatest market of the Wastes!
Raise a Dark Fortress to guard our lands!
It will stay a camp. A strong one.
Word of the camp at [chaos_settlement.GetName] has spread across our lands, and clansmen flock to it to trade, feast and fight. It already sends us fresh warriors.
A young warrior of [chaos_settlement.GetName] has gathered a great band of followers sworn to him alone. He says he will take the lands around the camp for himself. Nothing good will come of it.
Then let him come and take them.

[chaoshorde_old_chief.GetTitledName] has been murdered in [chaoshorde_old_chief.GetHerHis] own tent, and the camp at [chaos_settlement.GetName] is in uproar. The killer, [chaos_chief.GetTitledName], stands over the body and waits for your word.
Tell [chaos_chief.GetFirstName] to swear fealty to me, or die.
Kill the killer. The chieftain's heir takes the camp.
With no chieftain to govern it, the camp at [chaos_settlement.GetName] has fallen into ruin. Its people have drifted back to the herds, and your advisors say it is best torn down.
The Fate of Karag Dum
The ancient Dawi hold of Karag Dum has fallen to our warriors after a long and bitter siege. Its gates are broken and its halls run with dwarf blood. Now we must decide what to do with it.

column1: We could put everyone to the sword and take the hold for ourselves, accept the offer of a Dawi Zharr emissary who would put its forges and its people to work for Hashut, or burn it and leave the ruins to the warlords of the gods.

column2: We have finally wrested Karag Dum from our Dawi kin. Its forges are cold and its people in chains. It only remains to choose who will rule the hold in Hashut's name.
Put everyone to the sword! The hold is ours now.
Let us see what this emissary of the Dawi Zharr can offer...
Appoint a governor to manage the hold.
Burn it, and let the warlords of the gods fight over the ashes.
Da boyz in da army are talkin' about sum zoggin' paleface boss git smashin' Karag Dum before we could get our choppas in it...
The proud fortress of Karag Dum, which held back the tribes of the Wastes for centuries, has fallen. Across the Wastes, the warlords sharpen their blades for new invasions of the south.
The impregnable dwarf hold of Karag Dum, which watched over the Chaos Wastes for millennia, has been overrun by the forces of Chaos. It is a grim sign of the power gathering in the cold north.
Not so high and mighty now, kinsmen...
Not so impenetrable after all...
By [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName]! The forces of Chaos are getting ever closer!
By [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName]! This calls for a grudge!
Me don't care, ya zoggin' git!
That hold stood for too long anyway. Hmph!
Your warriors have razed [FromFrom.GetName] to the ground! Not one stone stands upon another, and the Dark Gods drink deep of the slaughter.
Hungry for loot and maddened by the defenders' resistance, your warriors ran riot in [FromFrom.GetName]. A fire broke out, and when the smoke cleared only ruins were left.
There's nothing left to occupy...
Hungry for loot, your warriors run riot in [FromFrom.GetName]. Several buildings are destroyed in the chaos.
Angered by the defenders' resistance, your warriors run wild in [FromFrom.GetName]. A fire breaks out and destroys much of the town before it burns itself out.
Your holding of [FromFrom.GetName] has been ruined by the warriors of [From.GetTitledName]!
A building was destroyed during the siege of [FromFrom.GetName].
Your captains ask how the warriors should treat the towns they take.
Let the men have their fun...
Why are you bothering me with this?
Try to keep them intact.
Put everyone to the sword!
Your warriors have slaughtered every soul in [FromFrom.GetName]! Bodies litter the streets and most of the town has burned.
The occupation of [FromFrom.GetName] turned into a bloodbath. Many buildings were destroyed before your captains restored order.

The death of warlord [From.GetFullName] has thrown the horde into turmoil. Ambitious warriors are seizing swathes of land for themselves, shaming the name of [From.GetOnlyDynastyName]. [nomadic_heir.GetFullName] must hold together what [nomadic_heir.GetHerHis] [GetFromRelation] built.
Do they not know who is the boss around here?!
Ah, glorious Chaos.
[Root.GetTitledName] has bent the lesser warbands that broke from the old horde to [Root.GetHerHis] will. Their chiefs now kneel before [Root.GetHerHim].
[Root.GetTitledName] has forced a neighbouring warband that broke from the old horde to kneel.

Runehammer of Karag Dum
A dwarf lord's hammer torn from the fallen hold of Karag Dum. Its runes still glow faintly, as if they have not yet accepted the fall.
Despoiler's Skull-Standard
A tall pole hung with the skulls of the lords of a razed town, carried before the warband so that every enemy knows what awaits them.
